notes:
- Scroll bars, on the right and at the bottom of your design, so you can always find your way around.
- The mouse wheel now scrolls up and down, like most programs. Hold Shift to scroll sideways, or Ctrl to zoom. If you prefer the wheel to zoom, turn on "Mouse wheel zooms (CorelDRAW style)" in the ? menu.
- Lost your design after zooming in? A big "Show my design" button brings it back.
- The Fit button now says "Fit to screen".
- When you pick where the test square goes, the part of your board the laser can't reach is shaded, and the square is always shown exactly where it will burn.
